partially_covered.missing: No explicit class or properties for displaying organization attributes beyond name, address, and identifier. Contact details, tax IDs, or other business-relevant attributes are not modeled.
ValidationConstraint and ShaclConstraint classes exist but there is no explicit list or restriction for mandatory identifiers or logic for D96A-required fields.

cq_coverage.details: Most competency questions are fully addressed through the class/property structure, especially for invoice, organization, item, pricing, and process assignment. CQ5 and CQ13 require additional modeling for full coverage.

strengths: Rich and deep class hierarchy reflecting EDIFACT structure
Good use of restrictions and equivalence axioms for pivot classes
Disjointness and disjoint unions are present
All classes and properties are annotated
weaknesses: No explicit general class axioms for cross-cutting constraints (e.g., mandatory fields per D96A)
Some detail lost in organization attributes and validation logic

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4: Missing domain or range for some properties (none detected here, but always possible with future extension)
P7: Missing inverse for some object properties (well-covered here, but complex inverses can cause confusion)
reasoner_risks: Complex restrictions on pivot classes may slow or confuse Hermit/Pellet on large datasets

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Extend Organization with additional business-relevant attributes (e.g., contact info, tax ID, legal registration) to fully answer CQ5.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Brings CQ5 to full coverage and enhances organization modeling.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Model concrete SHACL shapes or OWL restrictions to enumerate and enforce mandatory D96A identifiers and required fields for invoices (CQ13).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables automated validation and complete CQ13 coverage.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add more general class axioms (GCAs) for mandatory presence of certain properties (e.g., every InvoiceMessage must have at least one RoleAssignment for Buyer and Seller).
Enrich Segment, CompositeDataElement, and SimpleDataElement with code lists and technical vocabulary for specific EDIFACT segments (e.g., BGM, NAD, LIN).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Deepens EDIFACT-specific modeling and supports technical validation.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add example individuals and an EDIFACT message instance to illustrate ontology use.

summary: This ontology provides a highly structured, well-annotated, and OWL 2-compliant model for EDIFACT invoices and procurement, with deep hierarchies and appropriate use of restrictions and pivot classes. Most competency questions are fully covered, but further enrichment is needed for business-relevant organization attributes and explicit validation logic. The ontology is robust for reasoning and validation, with only minor enhancements required for full CQ and technical coverage.
